units.source_text: 明石小女公子将举行着裳仪式，源氏太政大臣用心准备，其周到非寻常可比。

en.t: The young lady of Akashi was soon to hold her coming of age robe ceremony, and Genji, the Grand Minister, prepared for it with extraordinary care.

units.source_text: 皇太子亦将于同年二月举行冠礼。

en.t: The Crown Prince too was to hold his coming of age ceremony in the second month of that same year.

units.source_text: 冠礼完成之后，小女公子即将入宫。

en.t: After the Crown Prince's ceremony was completed, the young lady was to enter the palace at once.

units.source_text: 且喜今天是正月底，公私均甚闲暇，源氏便命配制熏衣用的香剂。

en.t: Fortunately it was now the end of the first month, when both public and private affairs were quiet, so Genji ordered perfumes for scenting garments to be blended.

units.source_text: 太宰大弍奉赠香料若干。

en.t: The Assistant Governor General of Dazaifu presented him with a quantity of aromatic ingredients.

units.source_text: 源氏一看，觉得品质不及从前的好，便命打开二条院中的仓库，取出以前中国舶来的种种物品，比较之下，说道：“不但香料如此，绫罗缎匹也是从前的优良可爱。”

en.t: When Genji examined them, he felt that their quality was not as fine as in former days, so he had the storehouses at Nijo Palace opened and various old imports from China brought out for comparison, saying, "It is not only perfumes that were better before; silks, gauzes, and brocades too were once finer and more delightful."

units.source_text: 即将举行的着裳仪式中所需用的毯子、垫子和褥子，都须用绫罗镶边。

en.t: The carpets, cushions, and bedding needed for the robe ceremony soon to be held all had to be edged with fine silk.

units.source_text: 源氏命人把桐壶帝初年朝鲜人所进贡的绫罗金锦等今世所无的珍品取出来，分别派定用途。

en.t: Genji ordered rare treasures, such as silks and gold brocades presented by Koreans early in Emperor Kiritsubo's reign and no longer seen in the world, to be brought out, and he assigned each item its proper use.

units.source_text: 便把太宰大弍所赠绫罗赏赐了众侍女。

en.t: He then bestowed the silks sent by the Assistant Governor General of Dazaifu upon the waiting women.

units.source_text: 香料新旧两种都要，分送给院内各位夫人配制，对她们说：“请把两种各配一剂。”

en.t: He wanted both the new and the old aromatic ingredients, and he sent portions to each of the ladies in the residence to compound, telling them, "Please prepare one blend from each kind."

units.source_text: 赠人的物品，以及送公卿们的礼物，都很精美，世无其类。

en.t: The gifts for guests and the presents for the court nobles were all exquisitely fine and unlike anything else in the world.

units.source_text: 院内院外，都忙于准备。

en.t: Inside and outside the residence, everyone was busy with preparations.

units.source_text: 妇女们精选材料，捣制香剂，铁臼之声盈耳。

en.t: The women carefully selected the ingredients and pounded the perfumes, until the sound of iron mortars filled the ear.

units.source_text: 源氏独自闭居在离开正屋的一间别室中，悉心调制仁明天皇承和年间秘传下来的两种香剂：“黑方”与“侍从”。

en.t: Genji shut himself away alone in a detached room apart from the main house and devoted himself to blending two perfumes secretly handed down from the Jowa era of Emperor Ninmyo, "Kurobo" and "Jiju."

units.source_text: 这两种香剂的制法，向来不许传授给男子，不知他何由知道。

en.t: The methods for making these two perfumes had never been permitted to be taught to men, so no one knew how he had learned them.

units.source_text: 紫夫人则在正屋与东厢之间的别室深处设一座位，在那里依照八条式部卿亲王的秘方调制香剂。

en.t: Lady Murasaki, meanwhile, set up a seat deep in a side room between the main house and the eastern wing, and there she blended perfumes according to the secret recipe of Prince Hachijo, Minister of Ceremonial.

units.source_text: 大家非常秘密，互相竞争。

en.t: Everyone kept their work highly secret and competed with one another.

units.source_text: 源氏说：“我们当以香气的浓淡来判定胜负。”

en.t: Genji said, "Let us judge the contest by the depth and delicacy of the fragrance."

units.source_text: 他们像孩子一般赌赛，不像是做父母的人。

en.t: They wagered and competed like children, hardly seeming like people who were already parents.

units.source_text: 他们为了保守秘密，侍女也不许多人入内。

en.t: To preserve the secrecy, they did not allow many waiting women to enter either.

units.source_text: 各种器物，无不尽善尽美。

en.t: Every kind of utensil was perfected in both workmanship and beauty.

units.source_text: 就中香壶箱子的模样、香壶的形式、香炉的设计，无不新颖入时，别出心裁，为从来所未见。

en.t: Among them, the shapes of the perfume jar boxes, the forms of the perfume jars, and the designs of the incense burners were all fresh, fashionable, and ingenious, unlike anything seen before.

units.source_text: 源氏在各位夫人所用心调制的香剂中，选取其优良者，设法装入壶中。

en.t: From the perfumes that the ladies had carefully blended, Genji selected the finest and arranged to have them placed in jars.
